summary: Stone garden and field walls built of field stone and topped with stones on edge.
rationale: Appearance change: walls in the map at the game's camera, and one up close in the studio, from the same cameras. The wall's top is what a battle camera sees most of, so wall-top.jpg shows it before and after at 14 m, 32 m and up close; a native wall sweep exposes distance filtering and the stones' skyline under grazing light.

followup_capture.camera: native low_wall orthographic fixture, fitted size 1x to 3.5x and back
followup_capture.lighting: 12 degree sun elevation, azimuth -38 to 142 and back, fixed exposure
validation: Clean import; building-components passed (field-stone top: one cached part, field-stone surface, ragged skyline, kept to the wall's length, at most 1,500 vertices)
Matched before/after at 14 m and 32 m on aivai seed 3 and up close on the stage, Forward+; stage close-up under gl_compatibility
limits: Fixture, not gameplay or imported LOD validation
No hardware performance claim; the top is one cached mesh of about 1,100 vertices per 4 m wall
